title: Greystar Data Breach Lawsuit Investigation
subject: greystar
summary: Claim Depot reports that law firm Shamis & Gentile P.A. is investigating possible claims over the Greystar Real Estate Partners data breach. According to the page, an unauthorized party accessed an employee email account between May 1 and May 18, 2026, and Greystar began notifying people on Aug. 27, 2026. It cites filings showing at least 333 people affected in Washington and five in Massachusetts, adding the Massachusetts count and the law-firm investigation to the WA AG notice (greystar-data-breach-notice-wa-ag-2026).

title: Greystar notifies Washington AG of data breach involving employee email account
subject: greystar
outlet: Washington State Attorney General (data breach notification filing)
summary: Greystar Real Estate Partners filed a breach notice stating an unauthorized party accessed an employee email account between May 1 and May 18, 2026 and acquired files containing personal information; affected people were offered 24 months of credit monitoring. This is a mandatory disclosure, not an enforcement action; no lawsuit over this breach was found.

title: Major Landlord Accused Of Discriminating Against Section 8 Renters In Hawaii
subject: greystar
summary: Civil Beat reported that testers sent by a nonprofit were told by agents for Greystar that their vouchers would not work, in alleged violation of Hawaii's source-of-income protections.

title: National landlord with property in Virginia accused of housing discrimination
subject: greystar
summary: Virginia Mercury reported HRI complaints alleging Greystar-managed properties in Virginia refused or illegally conditioned housing-voucher applicants despite state source-of-income protections.

title: Kentucky Settles Antitrust Claims Against Greystar in RealPage Rent-Setting Case
subject: greystar
summary: Citing Law360, PYMNTS reports that Kentucky settled its antitrust claims against Greystar Management Services in AG Russell Coleman's RealPage suit, filed July 2025 in the Eastern District of Kentucky (kentucky-ag-v-realpage-greystar-2025). Terms were not disclosed. It adds that a federal judge had earlier let key claims proceed after Greystar sought dismissal, and that the complaint alleged hundreds of thousands of Kentucky renters were affected.

title: Greystar Settles Out Of Kentucky's RealPage Antitrust Case
subject: greystar
summary: Law360 reports that Kentucky settled its federal antitrust claims against Greystar Management Services, which the state alleged used RealPage revenue-management software to fix rents. This is the source of the July 2026 Greystar settlement noted on kentucky-ag-v-realpage-greystar-2025.

title: Largest landlord in the US accused of civil rights violations
subject: greystar
summary: The Guardian reported fair housing complaints accusing Greystar of refusing tenants who use federal Housing Choice Vouchers in places where that is illegal, alleging 114 violations across six states and D.C.

title: Wailuku Greystar property named in statewide housing voucher discrimination complaint
subject: greystar
summary: Maui Now reported that a Greystar property in Wailuku was among those named in Hawaii housing-voucher discrimination complaints filed by Housing Rights Initiative.

title: Greystar faces 114 housing voucher discrimination complaints
subject: greystar
summary: HousingWire reported HRI's 114 complaints in Virginia, California, Maryland, Hawaii, Michigan, New Jersey and D.C. alleging testers were told vouchers were not accepted, had to cover 100% of rent, or would not count toward income minimums. Greystar said it is committed to fair housing.

title: Housing watchdog files 114 voucher-discrimination complaints against Greystar with seven state and D.C. agencies
subject: greystar
location: CA, HI, MD, MI, NJ, VA, DC
summary: Housing Rights Initiative filed complaints with the Virginia OAG, California CRD, Maryland Commission on Civil Rights, Hawai'i Civil Rights Commission, Michigan DCR, New Jersey DCR and D.C. Office of Human Rights alleging 114 violations of source-of-income laws. The complaints allege, based on undercover testing, that Greystar properties rejected Housing Choice Voucher holders, imposed unlawful conditions, and refused to count voucher assistance toward income requirements.

title: Greystar Accused By Watchdog Of Discriminating Against Section 8 Voucher Users
subject: greystar
summary: Bisnow reported that Housing Rights Initiative filed complaints alleging Greystar properties refused or illegally conditioned housing-voucher applicants in jurisdictions with source-of-income protections, based on undercover testing.

title: Report looks at rise of 'junk fees' renters face at apartments managed by Greystar
subject: greystar
summary: Texas Standard discussed the Guardian's findings of 125 named fees at Greystar listings, noting Greystar manages about 200,000 units in Texas and that some leases carry five to eleven mandatory fees on top of rent.

title: 'Extremely overwhelmed': apartment renters face rising tide of fees
subject: greystar
summary: A Guardian investigation by Tracie McMillan counted at least 125 differently named fees at Greystar properties (e.g., boiler management, refrigerant, 'solar rebill' and 'lifestyle' fees) and reported tenant complaints of 'unfair' and 'inflated' charges, plus pending fee class actions in several states. Greystar denied the claims.

title: The hidden costs of renting in metro Detroit
subject: greystar
summary: WDET's The Metro interviewed Guardian reporter Tracie McMillan about her investigation into fees charged at Greystar-managed apartments and how they affect metro Detroit renters.

title: Greystar settlement will result in refunds for some Arizona renters
subject: greystar
summary: The Copper Courier reported that Arizona renters could recoup money paid to Greystar for hidden and junk fees from $1.6 million in settlements involving two Phoenix-area complexes.

title: Arizona AG announces three settlements with Greystar over hidden rental charges and junk fees
subject: greystar
summary: Arizona AG Kris Mayes announced three Assurances of Discontinuance entered in Maricopa County Superior Court: one adopting the injunctive terms of the FTC/Colorado settlement (with about $1.5M in anticipated restitution to Arizona consumers from the FTC fund), and two resolving alleged Arizona Consumer Fraud Act junk-fee violations at The Julia and Avana Gilbert with a combined $100,000 in restitution.

title: Greystar, the Largest Corporate Landlord in the US, Has a Shocking Track Record
subject: greystar
bob-faith
outlet: Housing Is A Human Right (AIDS Healthcare Foundation advocacy site)
summary: An advocacy piece compiling Greystar controversies under Bob Faith, including the RealPage price-fixing litigation, the FTC/Colorado hidden-fee case and fair housing complaints. Advocacy source; underlying claims should be checked against primary records.

title: Judge OKs Greystar Deal In DOJ's RealPage Price-Fixing Suit
subject: greystar
summary: According to Law360, a North Carolina federal judge gave final sign-off on March 2, 2026 to the Justice Department's antitrust settlement with Greystar Management Services in the federal RealPage rent price-fixing case. This finalizes the consent decree proposed in August 2025 (doj-greystar-realpage-consent-decree-2025).

title: Greystar California agrees to revise tenant screening statewide after fair housing complaint
subject: greystar
summary: CRD announced a settlement with Greystar California, Inc. after a complaint alleging an applicant at a Hollywood apartment complex was denied based on criminal history without an opportunity to explain. Greystar agreed to review and revise screening policies statewide, notify staff of California's criminal-history protections, train specified Southern California staff, and pay the complainant $10,000.

title: 'Scammed out of £20k': London students forced to move out of 'most exclusive' student hall
subject: greystar
summary: Residents of Chapter London Bridge, a premium student hall run by Greystar's Chapter brand, had to vacate after a major water leak caused a power outage in December 2025, with restoration expected to take until at least May 2026; students also cited earlier problems with lifts, water, electrics and a broken rubbish chute. One student said she felt 'scammed out of £20,000'; Chapter offered rooms at its other sites.

title: Greystar agrees to pay $24 million to settle FTC and Colorado hidden-fee case
subject: greystar
summary: Greystar agreed to pay $23 million to the FTC for consumer refunds and $1 million to Colorado, and to clearly and conspicuously display total monthly prices, including mandatory fees, in its rental listings.
cover_sub: The FTC's hidden-fee case against America's largest landlord, settled

title: Colorado settles hidden fees lawsuit against Greystar in the latest case resolved with landlord giant
subject: greystar
summary: Denver Post coverage of the FTC/Colorado $24 million hidden-fees settlement (ftc-colorado-greystar-24m-settlement-2025). It adds that the suit described two Denver complexes where fees allegedly pushed costs above advertised rent, and that Greystar operates more than 45,000 units in Colorado. It also quotes Greystar saying the deal 'enhances transparency' and notes Colorado's new rent-fee law takes effect Jan. 1.

title: Attorney General Phil Weiser, FTC announce $24M settlement with Greystar for misleading renters about costs, saddling tenants with hidden fees
subject: greystar
summary: Colorado's announcement of the FTC/Colorado hidden-fees settlement already recorded from the FTC side (ftc-colorado-greystar-24m-settlement-2025). This source adds the split: Colorado receives $1 million for costs, enforcement and consumer education, while the FTC receives $23 million for nationwide relief. It also lists the disclosure terms: total monthly price shown upfront, every fee itemized as mandatory or optional, and no upfront payment before full pricing is disclosed.

title: Greystar reaches $7M settlement in antitrust lawsuit over rent increases
subject: greystar
summary: Bay Area coverage of the nine-state $7 million RealPage settlement announced by California AG Rob Bonta (nine-state-ag-greystar-7m-settlement-2025). It adds a Greystar spokesperson statement and lists Greystar-managed properties in Mountain View and on the Peninsula. Bonta's office said it could not say whether Santa Clara or San Mateo County properties were affected.

title: Major landlord reaches $7M settlement with California, other states in alleged rent price scheme
subject: greystar
summary: The Long Beach Post reported Greystar's roughly $7 million settlement with California and other states over its alleged role in an algorithmic rent-pricing scheme.

title: Atlanta Magazine on the Avana on Main fire and the residents' lawsuit
subject: greystar
summary: In a feature on Atlanta apartment fires, Atlanta Magazine recounted the August 2020 Avana on Main fire that displaced more than 200 residents, and a now-settled residents' suit alleging an employee started it while working on rooftop HVAC units and that faulty fire alarms and expired extinguishers had gone unaddressed. The complex denied the allegations and settled with many residents; the residents' complaint (published by Law.com) named Greystar Management Services, L.P. as a defendant.
status: settled with many plaintiffs (per Atlanta Magazine)

title: North Carolina settles with Greystar in AI rent-fixing lawsuit
subject: greystar
summary: North Carolina coverage of the nine-state $7 million RealPage settlement announced by AG Jeff Jackson (nine-state-ag-greystar-7m-settlement-2025). It adds Jackson's estimate that more than 25,000 NC renters are affected and notes Greystar is the state's largest landlord. Third-party pricing software is allowed only under a court-appointed monitor, and Greystar and the states jointly moved to dismiss it from the 2024 federal suit.

title: Colorado reaches settlement with landlord giant Greystar in price-fixing lawsuit
subject: greystar
summary: Denver Post coverage of the nine-state $7 million RealPage settlement (nine-state-ag-greystar-7m-settlement-2025). It adds that Colorado would receive more than $1 million and that Gov. Polis vetoed a 2025 bill banning RealPage-style software. It also reports Greystar's statement that it was 'pleased this matter is resolved.'
status: settled $7M (proposed consent decree, pending before the court)

title: Oregon reaches $7M settlement with landlord giant Greystar in price-fixing lawsuit
subject: greystar
summary: Oregon coverage of the nine-state $7 million RealPage settlement with Greystar (nine-state-ag-greystar-7m-settlement-2025), announced by Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield. The states alleged Greystar shared information and used RealPage's algorithm to raise rents instead of competing. Contemporaneous Oregon coverage puts Greystar at almost 19,000 Portland units in 2023.

title: Nine state attorneys general reach $7 million settlement with Greystar over algorithmic rent pricing
subject: greystar
summary: The attorneys general of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Illinois, Massachusetts, Minnesota, North Carolina, Oregon and Tennessee filed a proposed $7 million settlement resolving their claims against Greystar Management Services in the January 2025 RealPage litigation. Greystar agreed to stop using pricing algorithms that rely on competitors' confidential data, accept a court-appointed monitor if using third-party pricing software, and cooperate against remaining defendants.

title: Attorney General Phil Weiser announces $7M settlement with Greystar for price-fixing scheme that drove up rents for Coloradans
subject: greystar
summary: Colorado AG release on the nine-state $7 million RealPage settlement (nine-state-ag-greystar-7m-settlement-2025). It adds that Colorado receives more than $1 million for antitrust and consumer-protection work. It also says Greystar is barred from revenue-management software that uses competitors' nonpublic data, and that the settling states may share in Greystar's cooperation with DOJ.

title: Greystar, others settle RealPage rental pricing lawsuit
subject: greystar
summary: Trade-press coverage of the RealPage MDL class settlements in the Middle District of Tennessee (realpage-mdl-greystar-50m-class-settlement-2025). It adds the full picture: 26 class settlements worth $141.8 million, with Greystar's $50 million the largest and Simpson, Avenue5, Bell, Bozzuto, Pinnacle and Winn also settling. Settlers agreed to stop sharing nonpublic data with RealPage's rent-setting algorithm, with no admission of wrongdoing.
status: settled $50M (class settlement pending before the court)

title: Greystar agrees to $50 million settlement in RealPage rental pricing lawsuit
subject: greystar
summary: Reuters report on Greystar's $50 million settlement of the renter class action in the RealPage MDL (realpage-mdl-greystar-50m-class-settlement-2025). Renters alleged Greystar and other landlords shared nonpublic data with RealPage to push rents above competitive levels. Greystar's deal was the largest in a group of preliminary class settlements totaling about $141 million.
status: settled $50M (class settlement pending before the court)

title: Greystar agrees to $50 million settlement in renters' RealPage price-fixing class action
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, M.D. Tenn. (In re RealPage, Inc., Rental Software Antitrust Litigation (No. II), 3:23-md-03071)
summary: In the consolidated private antitrust MDL alleging landlords used RealPage software to align rents, Greystar agreed to pay $50 million as part of more than $141 million in proposed settlements filed with 25+ landlords, and to stop sharing nonpublic data with RealPage. Greystar announced an agreement in principle on Aug. 8, 2025, stating it admitted no wrongdoing.

title: Students react to The Province ownership change
subject: greystar
summary: The University of Louisville student paper reported unsanitary conditions, inconsistent communication and a broken rent-payment portal as The Province transitioned from American Campus Communities to Greystar. It also noted WDRB reporting on student complaints of broken air conditioning and unsanitary conditions at Greystar-managed Trifecta Apartments.

title: Frustration reaches new level after disabled man's apartment floods twice
subject: greystar
summary: KOB 4 reported that a disabled Section 8 tenant's unit at Greystar-managed Copper Hills flooded in February and again in August, leaving ceiling holes, warped cabinets and ruined furniture; he said Greystar told him it could not help because he lacked renter's insurance. KOB said the leasing office was closed during business hours and it could not reach Greystar.

title: Why hasn't Blackstone settled the DOJ's RealPage price-fixing suit like peers Greystar and Cortland?
subject: greystar
summary: Advocacy-group commentary contrasting the Aug. 8, 2025 Greystar settlement with DOJ and state AGs (doj-greystar-realpage-consent-decree-2025) with Blackstone, which it says had not settled or announced it stopped using RealPage. It restates the Greystar terms: no competitor-data pricing algorithms, no sharing of sensitive pricing data, a court-appointed monitor, no RealPage landlord meetings, and cooperation against RealPage. It also says Greystar manages almost 950,000 units.

title: DOJ: Greystar to Stop Using 'Anticompetitive' Rent-Setting Software
subject: greystar
summary: ProPublica reported Greystar's proposed DOJ settlement barring it from algorithms that rely on rivals' nonpublic data and from sharing such data, resolving claims it colluded to raise rents; the story linked the case to ProPublica's 2022 RealPage investigation. Greystar admitted no wrongdoing.
status: proposed settlement, pending before the court

title: SC-based apartment giant settles suit over inflated rents
subject: greystar
summary: Greystar's hometown paper reported that the Charleston-based company agreed to settle a federal lawsuit alleging it worked with other landlords to keep rents high, and examined the possible effect on prices.

title: DOJ reaches proposed settlement with Greystar to end its participation in algorithmic pricing
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs
summary: DOJ filed a proposed final judgment barring Greystar from using rent-pricing software trained on or using other owners' nonpublic data, from sharing competitively sensitive data with rivals, and from attending RealPage-hosted meetings, and requiring cooperation in the ongoing case. Greystar said the settlement contained no admission of wrongdoing.

title: Littleton tenant sues Greystar alleging eviction in retaliation for silica dust complaints
subject: greystar
summary: A former tenant sued Greystar Management Services and a concrete contractor, alleging he was exposed to silica dust from concrete work, reported it to Greystar and OSHA (which fined the contractor more than $58,000), and was then evicted for allegedly 'photographing the vendors without consent.' Greystar denies most allegations and says it had no control over the contractor's work.

title: Grant v. Greystar: Kapilina Beach Homes tenant files federal RICO/fraud suit
subject: greystar
summary: A self-represented tenant sued Greystar Real Estate Partners, Kapilina Beach Homes and utility-billing firm Conservice, pleading civil RICO and fraud claims, according to the federal docket.

title: Kentucky AG sues RealPage and landlords including Greystar; Greystar later settles
subject: greystar
outlet: Kentucky Attorney General / U.S. District Court, E.D. Ky.
summary: Kentucky AG Russell Coleman sued RealPage and several landlords, including Greystar Real Estate Partners, alleging algorithmic price-fixing in violation of federal antitrust law and the Kentucky Consumer Protection Act. According to PYMNTS (July 21, 2026), Kentucky reached a settlement with Greystar Management Services; terms were not disclosed in public filings.

title: Greystar to pay over $1.4M for early-termination charges on military servicemembers
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Justice, Civil Rights Division / U.S. Attorney, D.S.C.
summary: DOJ alleged Greystar Management Services violated the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act by imposing early-termination charges on servicemembers who ended leases after receiving relocation orders, relying on software it knew would impose the charges automatically. Greystar agreed to set aside $1.35M for affected servicemembers and co-tenants (treble damages for those who paid), pay a $77,370 civil penalty, and adopt SCRA-compliant software and forms.

title: Littleton apartment tenants describe persistent bird infestation 'nightmare'
subject: greystar
summary: Tenants said hundreds of swallows nest on Building 8 each spring, leaving droppings, dead birds and bird mites that they say enter apartments, and described unfulfilled promises from management. Greystar told 9NEWS its options are limited because the swallows are protected under the Migratory Bird Treaty Act and it is deterring nesting in compliance with federal law.

title: Apartment manager Greystar faces more 'junk fee' lawsuits after FTC case
subject: greystar
summary: Reuters report that Greystar faced additional proposed class actions over alleged hidden 'junk fees' after the January 2025 FTC/Colorado suit (ftc-colorado-v-greystar-complaint-2025). Its timing matches the California suit filed in the Southern District of California in late April 2025 (wu-v-greystar-california-junk-fees-2025).

title: Class action alleges Greystar charged California tenants undisclosed junk fees
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, S.D. Cal. (Wu et al. v. Greystar Real Estate Partners, LLC, 3:25-cv-01090)
summary: The proposed class action alleges Greystar 'drip priced' California rentals by charging mandatory fees for pest control, trash and utility administration not included in advertised rent, in violation of the UCL, False Advertising Law, CLRA and California's Honest Pricing Law.

title: New Jersey AG sues RealPage and 10 landlords including Greystar for alleged rent collusion
subject: greystar
outlet: New Jersey Office of Attorney General / U.S. District Court, D.N.J.
summary: New Jersey alleged RealPage and 10 large landlords, including Greystar Management Services LLC, violated the Sherman Act, the New Jersey Antitrust Act and the Consumer Fraud Act by using RealPage's algorithmic pricing and exchanging nonpublic data to inflate rents.

title: Apartment giant Greystar accused of charging 'hidden fees' to tenants around U.S.
subject: greystar
summary: The Review-Journal reported on federal and Colorado allegations that Greystar engaged in deceptive advertising by omitting mandatory fees from advertised rents, including at Nevada properties.

title: Washington AG sues RealPage and landlords including Greystar over alleged rent price-fixing
subject: greystar
summary: Filed in King County Superior Court, the suit names Greystar Management Services, LLC and GREP Washington, LLC among landlords alleged to have conspired with RealPage to raise and stabilize rents and exchange nonpublic competitive information in Washington.

title: Washington class action challenges Greystar lease buy-out and reletting charges
subject: greystar
outlet: King County Superior Court (per plaintiffs' counsel Schroeter Goldmark & Bender)
summary: Filed on behalf of tenants who moved out early and were charged, or had deposits applied to, buy-out fees, reletting charges and/or future rent. Greystar removed the case to federal court, which remanded it to King County Superior Court.

title: FTC and Colorado AG sue Greystar over hidden mandatory rental fees
subject: greystar
outlet: Federal Trade Commission / U.S. District Court, D. Colo. (No. 1:25-cv-00165)
summary: The FTC and the State of Colorado sued Greystar Real Estate Partners and five affiliates, alleging that since at least 2019 the company advertised deceptively low base rents while failing to disclose mandatory monthly fees (pest control, valet trash, package, utility-administration and amenity fees), often until after a non-refundable application fee was paid. Claims were brought under the FTC Act, the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act and the Colorado Consumer Protection Act.
status: resolved by stipulated order Dec 2025 (see $24M settlement)

title: Greystar Facing FTC Lawsuit Over Hidden Renter Fees
subject: greystar
summary: Bisnow relayed a Wall Street Journal report that the FTC was preparing to sue Greystar over mandatory fees for items such as pest control, trash and background checks that were not disclosed in advertised rents.

title: DOJ Sues Large U.S. Landlords Over Alleged Price-Fixing
subject: greystar
summary: ProPublica reported that the Justice Department expanded its RealPage antitrust case to sue six large landlords including Greystar, alleging they shared competitively sensitive data to align rents.

title: Justice Department adds Greystar and five other landlords to RealPage antitrust suit
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Justice, Antitrust Division / U.S. District Court, M.D.N.C. (No. 1:24-cv-00710)
summary: DOJ and state co-plaintiffs (including North Carolina) filed an amended complaint naming Greystar, LivCor, Camden, Cushman & Wakefield/Pinnacle, Willow Bridge and Cortland, alleging they shared competitively sensitive data through RealPage's pricing algorithms and communicated directly about rents and occupancy. The complaint alleged, as one example, that Greystar supplied Camden with recent renewal rates and pricing approach information.
status: Greystar resolved via consent decree (see DOJ settlement)

title: 'Not fair': Elevator outages in Navy Yard high-rise upset residents
subject: greystar
summary: Residents of the 14-story Onyx on First said all three elevators had been mostly out of service for days, calling it a safety and accessibility problem. Greystar, the property manager, referred questions to the owner, which said repairs were underway and elevators were running four hours a day.

title: Residents petition Greystar for indoor air-quality testing at Forty55 Lofts
subject: greystar
summary: Petition started by resident Wendy K. alleges residents became seriously ill from formaldehyde and other indoor toxins above health guidelines, that requests for testing and remediation were ignored, that residents were forced to take legal action, and that Greystar continues to rent untested units. It asks that Greystar be required to test and confirm units are habitable; it had 108 signatures when reviewed.

title: Luxury downtown high-rise residents frustrated over building's faulty elevators
subject: greystar
summary: Residents of the Ascent at Peachtree high-rise said repeated elevator outages over several months forced them to climb multiple flights of stairs. FOX 5 said it made multiple attempts to reach Greystar, the property manager, without a response at publication.

title: Welton Park Apartments Go More Than a Week Without Water
subject: greystar
summary: Yellow Scene reported that residents of Welton Park, managed by Greystar, went about ten days without clean running water affecting roughly 195 units, and described the outage as part of a pattern of alleged mismanagement.

title: Tenant issues warning on major property management company
subject: greystar
summary: The Daily Dot covered a viral TikTok (over 323,000 views) in which a tenant identified as B. called Greystar 'one of the worst property management companies' she had encountered and said she wanted to break her 15-month lease within 30 days over unenforced policies.

title: Arizona AG sues RealPage and nine landlords, including Greystar, over alleged rent price-fixing
subject: greystar
summary: Arizona alleged RealPage and nine landlords, including Greystar Management Services, L.P., conspired to raise rents in the Phoenix and Tucson metro areas by pooling competitively sensitive pricing and occupancy data in RealPage's software.

title: Tenant alleges management misstated lease-end terms and is holding them two extra months
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges management gave written instructions about ending the lease that conflicted with the lease, and is now requiring two additional months of tenancy; reviewer says escalations to Greystar went unanswered.

title: Senior community resident alleges intimidation and refusal to address tenant harassment
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer at a 55+ community alleges management staff were aggressive and intimidating toward residents who complained, practiced favoritism, and said they would not intervene in tenant-on-tenant harassment.

title: Colorado family charged $4,000 in fees after loved one dies unexpectedly, landlord says death meant she broke her lease
subject: greystar
summary: After tenant Leticia Farrer died in January 2024, her family was billed about $4,140 in early-termination and concession fees at the Greystar-managed Avenida; the lease said tenants were not released 'for any reason, including death.' Greystar cleared the balance after the story; Colorado later passed 'Letty's Act' (HB25-1108) to bar such fees.

title: Class Action Lawsuit Targets Colorado's Largest Apartment Management Company Over 'Junk Fees'
subject: greystar
summary: Coverage of a proposed class action filed in Denver District Court by tenant Nichole Collins, alleging Greystar charged undisclosed mandatory fees for pest control, valet trash and billing (nearly $40/month) not included in advertised rent. Represented by Towards Justice and Justice for the People Legal Center.

title: 18-year resident alleges declining service, fire-alarm errors and understaffed maintenance
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges conditions declined after Greystar took over, including a misdirected fire-alarm response that nearly led the fire department to break down their door, slow snow removal, a fitness fee despite broken equipment, a pool closed most of summer 2023, and one maintenance worker for 232+ units.

title: Colorado tenant class action accuses Greystar of charging inflated junk fees
subject: greystar
outlet: District Court, Denver County, Colorado (Collins v. GREP Southwest, LLC d/b/a Greystar)
summary: The class complaint alleges Greystar forced thousands of Colorado tenants to pay inflated, late-disclosed 'junk fees' on top of advertised rent that provided no benefit beyond ordinary landlord costs, and seeks to stop the practice and recover damages.

title: Tenant alleges $2,000 deposit not returned within state-law deadline
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a $2,000 security deposit was still unreturned three months after move-out, beyond the state-law deadline, and that corporate phone lines led only to voicemail; reviewer describes the units as unsafe and unhealthy.

title: New tenant alleges unaddressed roach infestation at move-in
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a unit managed by Greystar was filthy and roach-infested at move-in in November 2023 and that the infestation remained unresolved weeks later, citing an Arizona statute and stating an intent to hire a lawyer.

title: Boston tenants' class action alleges Greystar entity charged unlawful eviction legal fees
subject: greystar
outlet: Boston Globe (U.S. District Court, D. Mass.)
summary: Tenants of The Eddy in East Boston sued Greystar affiliate GREP Atlantic and the building owner, alleging 'eviction/legal recovery' fees were charged without a court judgment, in violation of the Massachusetts Consumer Protection Act. The court dismissed one claim but allowed two to proceed, and allowed some Greystar counterclaims.

title: D.C. Attorney General sues RealPage and 14 landlords, including Greystar, for rental price-fixing
subject: greystar
outlet: Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia
summary: The D.C. OAG complaint names Greystar Management Services, L.P. among 14 landlords alleged to have collectively delegated rent-setting to RealPage's revenue-management software in violation of the District's Antitrust Act. It alleges Greystar operates about 7,730 D.C. units and used RealPage software at buildings including The Gantry and Illume.
status: pending as to Greystar (no Greystar settlement found)

title: Tenant alleges refund reversed after move-out and early-morning unannounced entry attempts
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that a deposit refund confirmed in writing after move-out was later recast as a balance owed, that all mailboxes used a common key, and that maintenance tried to enter the unit as early as 6 a.m. and on weekends without work orders.

title: Bellevue renter seeks assistance for growing mold problem
subject: greystar
summary: A tenant at Avana Lexington told NewsChannel 5 he no longer felt comfortable living in his apartment because of a spreading mold problem. A Greystar spokesperson said the resident had filed a work order two days earlier and the company was investigating.

title: Student alleges $2,005 pre-lease payment not refunded
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer, a college student, alleges they were required to pay a month's rent before receiving any lease terms on a promise of a full refund if unsatisfied, and that requests for that refund went unanswered.

title: Tenant alleges malfunctioning smoke/fire alarm and unanswered emergency line
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a smoke/fire alarm in their unit kept malfunctioning without repair and that the after-hours emergency number rang without answer.

title: Tenant alleges roach-infested unit at move-in and repairs tied to steep rent hikes
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges the apartment was infested with cockroaches at move-in, upper floors had soft, patched flooring, and leaks between units were common. Reviewer alleges repairs were being made mainly in units whose rent had risen more than 30% in two years, and that online rent payment carried fees.

title: Tenant alleges repeated ceiling leaks, mildew painted over and roach infestation
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges extensive water damage, with water coming through the kitchen ceiling three times in three years and a ruined light fixture left unreplaced for 10 months, and that repairs involved painting over mildew and nailing plywood over rotting boards. Reviewer also reports an uncontrolled German cockroach infestation.

title: Tenant alleges roaches, safety problems and move-out fees despite spotless unit
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges no meaningful response to cockroaches, multiple fires on the property, drug activity and squatters without a management response, a valet trash fee for unreliable pickup, and move-out fees despite leaving the unit spotless after completing the lease.

title: Tenant alleges unsanitary conditions and lack of ADA access alongside rising fees
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges hallways often had animal waste, dumpsters routinely overflowed, and the property lacks elevators and adequate accessible parking, while Greystar continued raising rent and adding fees.

title: Former tenant alleges withheld deposit, double-rent holdover and surprise charge two years later
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges they were not allowed to end the lease on time and were charged an extra month at double rent, the deposit was withheld without an itemized list, and a new $200 repair charge was raised two years after move-out. Reviewer says staff would not provide a move-out checklist or walk-through.

title: Tenant alleges failed toilet repair led to mold and deposit was kept
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a toilet that broke again after repair was never fixed, leading to mold discovered at move-out, and that the full deposit was withheld although the damage stemmed from the repairs. Reviewer also reports unexplained rent increases.

title: Student tenants allege months without dishwasher, termites and coercive move-out cleaning charge
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges repair requests were ignored for months, including no dishwasher for half the lease, and recurring termites were never fully treated. Reviewer alleges management threatened to keep the whole security deposit unless tenants paid for a deep clean, which the reviewer believes is unlawful.

title: Tenant alleges unrepaired bedroom leak for months and 30% rent increase
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges rain caused major bedroom leaks beginning in January that remained unrepaired months later with no rent abatement despite repeated calls and emails, followed by a 30% rent increase at renewal.

title: Long-time tenant alleges legal threats over late rent after Greystar takeover
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after Greystar took over from a smaller manager, being even two hours late on rent brings a late fee and threats of legal action within days, maintenance became slow, and the office never answers the phone.

title: Tenant alleges eviction attempt over landlord's own accounting error and flooding from new roofs
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges management tried to evict them for nonpayment due to an accounting error on management's side, that newly replaced roofs leaked and flooded apartments, and that a clogged disposal went unrepaired. Reviewer also reports a nearly $600 increase offered at renewal.

title: Tenant alleges unsecured buildings, needles on grounds and advertised pool closed for years
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges building doors lacked working locks so people slept in stairwells, packages were frequently stolen, and residents found used needles on the grounds. Reviewer also alleges the advertised pool had been inoperable for years and that management repeatedly reminded tenants it was not obligated to salt icy lots and steps.

title: Tenant alleges six-month dishwasher repair delay that hid a leaking pipe
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges stagnant water sat in the dishwasher for over six months despite repeated requests, and that when repairs finally occurred a burst pipe was found slowly leaking into the kitchen cabinet. Reviewer also alleges tenant safety was disregarded.

title: Tenant alleges nearly three months' rent in charges for early move-out plus unused service fees
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after five months they were charged nearly three months' rent to leave early, combining a two-month termination fee and an 'insufficient notice fee', while also paying for pest control that did not stop roaches and a valet trash service no one used.

title: Dallas jury returns $860 million verdict against Greystar over fatal 2019 crane collapse
subject: greystar
outlet: The Real Deal (Dallas County district court verdict)
summary: A Dallas County jury awarded about $860 million to the parents of a resident killed when a tower crane at a Greystar development collapsed onto the neighboring Elan City Lights apartments during a June 2019 storm. Plaintiffs argued Greystar let the crane's inspection lapse and was responsible for the crane not being left in weathervane mode; the jury found crane owner Bigge not liable.

title: Old East Dallas crane collapse: Jury returns $860 million verdict against real estate developer Greystar
subject: greystar
summary: A Dallas County jury awarded more than $860 million to the family of Kiersten Smith, killed in the 2019 crane collapse, finding Greystar bore responsibility; crane supplier Bigge Crane was not found at fault. Plaintiffs argued the crane was left unable to weathervane during the storm.

title: Senators Push DOJ To Crack Down On RealPage-Led Rent Inflation
subject: greystar
summary: Bisnow reported that Sens. Warren, Smith, Sanders and Markey urged the DOJ Antitrust Division to investigate RealPage's rent-setting algorithm, citing large users including Greystar.

title: Gamez v. Greystar: pro se civil rights suit naming Greystar and CEO Bob Faith
subject: greystar
bob-faith
outlet: U.S. District Court, E.D. Wash. (No. 2:23-cv-00015); 9th Cir. No. 23-35403
summary: A self-represented tenant filed a civil rights suit against Greystar Real Estate Partners, Bob Faith (individually and in his official capacity), a property-owning LLC, Spokane County, a law firm and others. The district case closed in May 2023; the Ninth Circuit appeal, which the clerk flagged as possibly frivolous, closed in September 2023.

title: Former tenants allege abusive post-move-out collection calls from Greystar accounting
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewers in two separate posts allege that an employee in Greystar's corporate accounting/collections department repeatedly called former tenants after move-out, shouting and using what they describe as illegal tactics, and urged others to file complaints with the BBB and the D.C. Attorney General.

title: Warren, Smith, Sanders, Markey question RealPage CEO on YieldStar landlord 'cartel'
subject: greystar
outlet: Office of U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren
summary: Four senators wrote to RealPage's CEO about whether YieldStar created a landlord 'cartel' driving up rents, noting Greystar, the largest U.S. property manager, used the software to set rents for more than 150,000 apartments.

title: How a Secret Rent Algorithm Pushes Rents Higher
subject: greystar
summary: ProPublica's investigation of RealPage's YieldStar software, which legal experts said could enable cartel-like rent setting using competitors' private data, named Greystar among large property managers using it; RealPage marketing said Greystar outperformed its markets by 4.8% in a downturn.

title: Greystar Property Management neglecting DTLA properties, City deems SB Main uninhabitable
subject: greystar
property: SB Main (Board of Trade Building), 111 W 7th St
summary: 2UrbanGirls reported that the City of Los Angeles deemed the Greystar-managed SB Main building uninhabitable on Sept. 1, 2022 and ordered repairs by Oct. 12. Residents documented non-working elevator lighting, mold from unrepaired leaks, debris in stairwells and a front door that would not close.

title: Greystar enters fair housing agreement with Equal Rights Center after Virginia voucher testing
subject: greystar
summary: Following a civil rights testing investigation by the Equal Rights Center (a fair housing nonprofit, not a government agency), GREP Atlantic, LLC agreed to a five-year agreement covering all Greystar-managed Virginia properties: income requirements based only on the tenant's rent share for voucher holders, no credit-score screening where a voucher covers full rent, signage and training, and 20 compliance tests.

title: Greystar pays $4.665 million to settle North Carolina eviction-fee class action
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, M.D.N.C. (Wallace v. Greystar Real Estate Partners, LLC, 1:18-cv-00501)
summary: Tenants alleged Greystar unlawfully charged North Carolina residents filing fees, sheriff service fees and attorneys' fees in eviction actions and threatened such fees in collection letters (2014-2018), in violation of state rental and debt-collection law. Greystar agreed to a $4,665,000 class settlement without admitting wrongdoing (final fairness hearing July 22, 2022).

title: When Private Equity Becomes Your Landlord
subject: greystar
bob-faith
summary: ProPublica's analysis of private-equity-backed apartment buyers featured tenants of San Francisco's Olume, who described soaring rents, trash in hallways and reduced security after Greystar took over in 2017 through a Freddie Mac-financed deal. The story profiles founder Bob Faith as a pioneer of connecting institutional investors with apartment buying; Greystar said resident satisfaction was 'very important.'

title: Greystar pays $2.5 million to settle Washington tenant screening-fee class action
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, E.D. Wash. (Daley v. Greystar, 2:18-cv-00381)
summary: The class alleged Greystar charged rental applicants in Washington tenant-screening fees without the advance disclosures state law requires (applications June 2016 - August 2020). Greystar denied wrongdoing and agreed to a $2.5 million settlement, which the court finalized Feb. 1, 2022.

title: Charlotte tenant sues over water damage at Greystar-managed luxury tower
subject: greystar
summary: WCNC reported a SkyHouse Uptown tenant's repeated water-damage incidents and her description of 'a lackadaisical approach from management'; she sued Greystar in 2022 alleging failure to perform necessary maintenance.

title: Life at The Grand Apartments Is Anything but Grand, Tenants Say
subject: greystar
summary: Westword reported tenant accounts of floods, power outages, unsanitary conditions and property damage at the 508-unit complex behind Union Station, along with fire department involvement. Tenants said Greystar, the property manager, was unresponsive to complaints.

title: Prop 65 notice alleges formaldehyde exposure at Greystar-managed Forty55 Lofts
subject: greystar
outlet: California Attorney General, Proposition 65 60-Day Notice (AG No. 2021-02813)
summary: A private noticing party filed a Proposition 65 60-day notice alleging exposure to formaldehyde gas from laminate flooring, cabinetry and/or other building materials, naming GS Redwood Property LLC, GS Redwood REIT LLC, Greystar Real Estate Partners LLC, Greystar California Inc. and Greystar Worldwide LLLC.

title: More than 50 displaced residents sue Greystar over 2020 Avana on Main apartment fire
subject: greystar
outlet: State Court of Fulton County, Georgia (No. 21EV004936)
summary: Residents displaced by the Aug. 19, 2020 fire at Avana on Main sued GS Main Street, LLC, Greystar Management Services, L.P. and a service technician, seeking damages arising from the fire.

title: Despite CDC moratorium, corporate landlords have gone on eviction spree
subject: greystar
summary: Raw Story reported eviction-tracking data showing that corporate landlords including Invitation Homes, MAA and Greystar were among those filing the most evictions after the September 2020 CDC eviction moratorium was announced.

title: Class action challenges Greystar late-fee and penalty practices in California
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, N.D. Cal. (Zeff v. Greystar Real Estate Partners, LLC, 3:20-cv-07122)
summary: The complaint alleges Greystar charged $100 late fees untethered to actual damages, applied rent payments to prior penalties first so late fees 'stacked' month to month, charged unauthorized $3.95 utility-administration fees, and mishandled security-deposit deductions and return timelines under California law.

title: Class action accuses Greystar and nine other managers of hiding Facebook housing ads from older renters
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, D. Md. (Opiotennione v. Bozzuto Management Co., 8:20-cv-01956)
summary: Housing Rights Initiative and an older D.C. resident sued 10 property managers, including Greystar, alleging they targeted Facebook apartment ads to exclude users over 50; they had earlier filed age-bias charges with D.C. and Montgomery County human rights offices (Sept. 2019). The district case closed in July 2021 and the Fourth Circuit affirmed dismissal on standing grounds in March 2025.

title: These are the real estate execs Trump tapped to help restart the economy
subject: bob-faith
summary: The Real Deal reported that Robert Faith of Greystar was named to the real estate panel of President Trump's Great American Economic Revival Industry Groups in April 2020, alongside executives such as Blackstone's Jonathan Gray and Related's Stephen Ross. (Factual record of an advisory appointment; no allegation of wrongdoing.)

title: Elan City Lights tenants: 'What are we going to do?'
subject: greystar
summary: After a construction crane fell onto the Greystar-owned Elan City Lights building on June 9, 2019, killing resident Kiersten Smith and injuring five others, displaced tenants described uncertainty as Greystar's hotel and daily-needs payments were set to end that Friday.

title: Tenant alleges repeated appliance failures, unauthorized entry and ignored theft reports at Tustin complex
subject: greystar
bob-faith
summary: Reviewer alleges appliances failed repeatedly after a management change in 2013, that staff entered her apartment without 24-hour notice, and that thefts she reported to management, a regional supervisor, and Greystar's CEO were never investigated. Reviewer also alleges she had to buy her own dryer after management refused to replace a failing unit.

title: Berkeley balcony fall victims settle with building owner
subject: greystar
summary: Victims of the June 2015 Library Gardens balcony collapse, which killed six young people (five Irish students and one from Rohnert Park) and injured seven, reached a confidential settlement with owner BlackRock and property manager Greystar. The parties agreed to adopt regular balcony-inspection policies.

title: Employee lawsuit alleges Greystar miscalculated overtime by excluding bonuses
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, N.D. Tex. (Norris v. Greystar Management Services LP, 3:17-cv-01956)
summary: A proposed collective action under the Fair Labor Standards Act alleges Greystar Management Services failed to include non-discretionary bonuses in the regular rate used to compute overtime pay.

title: NLRB issues complaint against Greystar Management Services over coercive work rules
subject: greystar
summary: After an unfair labor practice charge filed in January 2017, the NLRB regional office issued a complaint and notice of hearing alleging violations of Section 8(a)(1), including coercive rules and retaliation for concerted activity. A Regional Director order was issued in June 2018 and the case is closed.

title: Tenants say Greystar's check for a mold small-claims judgment was returned unpaid
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewers allege they won a small-claims case against Greystar/Bay Street Apartments for furniture damage and evacuation costs caused by ongoing water intrusion and mold, but that Greystar delayed payment and then stopped payment on its settlement check, which was returned. They report receiving a replacement check about three months after the ruling.

title: Mass Eviction—San Jose's Largest—to Displace 670 People
subject: greystar
summary: San Jose Inside reported that the City Council voted 7-3 to deny tenant appeals and allow Greystar to demolish the 216-unit rent-controlled Reserve for a 640-unit project, displacing about 670 people in what it called possibly Silicon Valley's largest eviction. Relocation help was offered only to lower-income households (about 40 units).

title: Hall v. Greystar Management Services: Fair Housing Act retaliation and eviction-property suit
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, D. Md. (No. 1:13-cv-03615), 179 F. Supp. 3d 534
summary: A former tenant sued Greystar Management Services, a landscaping contractor and a sheriff's lieutenant, alleging Fair Housing Act retaliation, conversion and constitutional claims arising from the alleged deprivation of her personal property during a December 2011 eviction. The case went to the Fourth Circuit (No. 14-2145) and back; the district court issued further rulings in 2016 and the docket closed in February 2017 without a judgment for the plaintiff.

title: Greystar Management Services pays $25,000 to settle EEOC pregnancy discrimination suit
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. EEOC / U.S. District Court, D. Md. (No. 11-cv-02789)
summary: The EEOC sued in October 2011 alleging Greystar fired a housekeeper at a Rockville, Md., apartment complex after she disclosed her pregnancy and demanded medical documentation clearing her to work with cleaning chemicals. A 30-month consent decree required $25,000 in relief, an anti-discrimination policy, manager training and a posted notice.

title: Former Riverstone tenant alleges withheld deposit, late move-out statement and collections referral
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after an agreed early lease termination, Riverstone Residential stopped communicating, sent the move-out statement after the 14-day legal window, kept the full deposit plus additional charges, and referred the account to collections without first attempting to collect.

title: Tenant alleges management threatens residents who complain at Gateway Lakes
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges management responds to complaints mainly by threatening residents, failed to act on threats from neighbors, charged for valet trash service that was not provided, and advertised a gated community that was not gated. Reviewer also reports an ant infestation and a unit that differed from the model shown.

title: Tenant alleges registered car towed as abandoned during paving work
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges their registered vehicle was tagged as abandoned and towed after being moved during confusing repaving notices, and that management defended the tow. Reviewer also alleges the pool gates did not lock, creating a safety hazard. A commenter on the report disputed the reviewer's account.

title: Tenant alleges eviction over $500 fee dispute followed by $7,700 bill
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges Greystar pursued eviction over $500 in legal fees after partly late rent, proceeded with the eviction despite an arranged payment deal with the manager, and then billed $7,700 in early-termination and other charges that went to collections.

title: Family alleges Greystar complex barred next of kin from deceased tenant's apartment
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after a long-term tenant died, management disabled the lock and refused her only next of kin access to retrieve clothing and photos, while allowing cleaners in without notice; access came only after the family obtained a court order. Reviewer further alleges the unit's walls were covered in black mold from a water leak in the unit above.

title: HUD conciliation agreement with Greystar over alleged harassment of Hispanic tenants in Nashville
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (FHEO Case No. 04-12-0360-8)
summary: A HUD Secretary-initiated Fair Housing Act complaint filed Feb. 10, 2012 alleged TriTex Real Estate Advisors and Greystar Management Services subjected Hispanic residents of the 233-unit Clairmont Apartments to different terms, intimidation and harassment based on national origin. Respondents denied discrimination and entered a conciliation agreement without any finding of liability.

title: Tenant alleges open security gates amid robberies and poor water service
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges the advertised secure gates were left open all day despite several robberies, with management responding only by email asking residents to report suspicious activity. Reviewer also reports very low water pressure, intermittent hot water, and thin walls.

title: Tenant alleges eviction notice over promised rent credit and misstated square footage
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a promised move-in rent credit was never applied, that an eviction notice was posted while the billing dispute was pending, and that the unit's square footage did not match the floor plan; reviewer says they asked the City of Los Angeles to inspect. Reviewer reports other tenants experienced similar billing errors.

title: Tenant alleges new Greystar management refused partial rent and moved straight to eviction
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after a job loss, newly arrived Greystar management refused a partial rent payment and began eviction within weeks while adding daily late fees and attorney fees, despite a year and a half of on-time payments.

title: Riverstone tenant alleges surprise move-out bill and mold-riddled units
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges Riverstone Residential management at a Tualatin complex charged move-out fees tied to incoming tenants, changed move-out dates, and issued a final bill that differed from earlier written figures, and that corporate said it had no grievance process. Reviewer also alleges the units were mold-ridden and that maintenance advised tenants to spray mold with a bleach solution themselves.

title: Denver tenant alleges unaddressed bed bugs and months of broken lighting
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges the buildings were infested with bed bugs and management never notified residents, treating single units so the bugs spread. Reviewer also alleges about a third of parking-lot and stairway lights had been out for nearly a year amid reported vehicle break-ins.

title: EEOC sues Greystar Holdings for retaliating against employee over harassment complaint
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. EEOC / U.S. District Court, D. Ariz. (CV-09-2003-PHX-FJM)
summary: The EEOC alleged Greystar Holdings, Inc. (d/b/a Greystar Real Estate Partners) gave a former employee a negative reference and recommended against hiring her because she had filed a sexual harassment complaint, in violation of Title VII.

title: Denver tenant alleges unkept repair appointments, infestations and tenants forced out for complaining
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges repair appointments were routinely not kept, the complex became vermin-infested and crime-ridden, and residents who complained about repairs were pushed out. Reviewer alleges the lease makes departing or evicted tenants liable for both sides' attorney fees and that damage from neglected repairs is deducted from deposits.

title: Riverstone tenant alleges lease terms changed mid-lease to add utility charges
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer, a Desert Storm veteran, alleges that after the complex was sold the new management changed the lease before it expired and added new water, trash and sewer charges billed through a third-party company. Reviewer also alleges inconsistent enforcement of the lease's pet rules.
